label: Explanation
resolution: Coextension classifies; Grounds represents metaphysical dependence; Produces represents formative change; Identifies represents an agent identifying a bearer; shared Explains is putative explanation of being F without a specified mechanism. No relation implies another without an explicit bridge. Grounding asymmetry applies only to Grounds. Base features are fixed model inputs, not hidden definitions of human nature. A Form essentially F is not thereby a particular exemplifying F.
